localChanges: Same defect as `lib/procedure.js` had, reintroduced by writing a new driver: it compiled and then formatted, so the emitted `.js` and its map described the pre-prettier source. ts-morph writes `static readonly transient = ['_a', '_b', '_c'];` on one line and prettier wraps it past 80 columns, so 23 of the 24 rollout commits held a `.js` with the one-line array against a `.ts` with the wrapped one.

Harmless in itself — the same array either way — and that is the point: it compiles, it tests, it publishes, and the artifact simply does not match its source. The 23 commits have been rebuilt and amended, and a second format/compile/format pass over all 24 now changes nothing.
